title: Smart Data Models - DigitalAsset
description: A concrete digital asset (web site, mobile app, social media profile, search engine listing, paid-ads account, etc.) that belongs to a Brand and is observed through a specific SoftwareApplication (e.g. Google Analytics 4, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Business). One Brand can group N DigitalAssets.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be DigitalAsset.

digitalAssetUrl.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. Canonical URL of the channel itself: the page being measured for a Web channel, the LinkedIn organization URL for a social profile, the app store URL for a mobile app, etc. Differs from Brand.url which is the brand landing

digitalAssetKind.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. High-level kind of the digital channel. Optional: helps consumers filter without having to introspect SoftwareApplication. Extend the enum if a new kind is needed; treat 'Other' as a temporary catch-all and request a proper value via PR. Enum:'Web, MobileApp, SocialProfile, SearchEngine, PaidAds, VideoPlatform, Email, Newsletter, Podcast, Marketplace, Other'

externalId.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Native identifier of the channel inside its SoftwareApplication. Examples: GA4 property id ('properties/123456789'), LinkedIn organization id, Meta business id. Optional but recommended for traceability and joins back to source systems

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

refBrand.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. URN of the Brand that owns this channel

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

refSoftwareApplication.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. URN of the SoftwareApplication used to measure or operate this channel (e.g. urn:ngsi-ld:SoftwareApplication:GoogleAnalytics4)
